channel.title: AnyRouter Changelog
channel.description: What shipped in each AnyRouter release: new models, routing, keys, CLI and site changes.

item.title: AnyRouter 1.6: name a model family, always get a live model
item.description:
Send a -latest id and AnyRouter calls the newest available model in that family. This release also adds new models, in-place BYOK key replacement, a read-only analytics scope for management keys, and a redesigned site.

  • Models: -latest aliases such as google/gemini-flash-latest resolve to the newest live model in a family. They are listed in /api/v1/models and have their own model pages.
  • Models: New in the catalog: GPT-6.1 Sol and Step 5 Preview, plus a DeepInfra route for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
  • BYOK: Replace a BYOK key in place and keep its id, label and routing settings. anyr byok rotate antigravity re-uploads a refreshed token for you.
  • API and keys: A new read-only read:analytics scope lets a management key read /analytics/* and nothing else.
  • Routing: A client hanging up no longer cools a route or sidelines your BYOK key, and routes that support reasoning are preferred.
  • Apps and site: The new SLM Matrix mini-app ranks small models by task. The landing, pricing, models and apps pages share a new print-style design.
